headlines.headline: TRAIL BLAZERS LAND JA MORANT IN TRADE WITH GRIZZLIES
headlines.detail: Portland acquired former All-Star guard Ja Morant from Memphis, alongside Kawhi Leonard's two-year, $115M extension with Toronto and DeMar DeRozan's one-year deal with Denver. NBA training camps open September 29.

headlines.headline: 49ERS OPEN 2-0 WITH 62 POINTS IN TWO BLOWOUT WINS
headlines.detail: Brock Purdy has yet to be sacked through two games as Kyle Shanahan's offense rolls. Giants QB Jaxson Dart is set for season-ending knee surgery, and the Cowboys head to Rio de Janeiro for the NFL's first-ever game in Brazil against the Ravens.

headlines.headline: OLE MISS' TRINIDAD CHAMBLISS MAKES HEISMAN CASE VS. LSU
headlines.detail: Chambliss went 33-for-48 for 363 yards and two TDs through the air, adding a rushing score, in a statement win over LSU. No. 11 Texas Tech improved to 3-0 and Indiana's Josh Hoover has the Hoosiers rolling in their title defense.

headlines.headline: TRANSFER PORTAL AND ELIGIBILITY FIGHTS RESHAPE 2026-27 CONTENDERS
headlines.detail: Emmanuel Ogbole won a TRO for an extra year of eligibility, and Texas A&M has injunction hearings this week over transfers Jordan Pope and Rylan Griffen. Washington filled its roster with six transfer additions, including Rutgers guard Harun Zrno.
